Welcome to ObiSky!

ObiSky is an upcoming community-based Minecraft: Bedrock Edition server! Our goal is to create a unique gaming experience for our players.

The server features our own touch of SkyWars: 3 lives, OP items, quick refills.

Join our Discord community to stay up to date with server news and join our amazing community!
